FlameStack

Stacks ground items and redstone-machine outputs to reduce server load; public listing advertises Folia support.

Performance

  • Item stacking
  • Redstone
  • Performance
  • Folia
View on BuiltByBit

What it does

FlameStack stacks ground items and redstone-machine outputs to reduce server load. Its tags — item stacking, redstone, performance and Folia — describe two kinds of stacking: the loose items that accumulate fastest on the ground, and the outputs a redstone machine leaves behind. The Folia tag records the runtime support the public listing advertises. In ArkFlame's Performance set it is entity-count reduction aimed at the tick loop.
